provenance.construction: 2BGA (arXiv:2306.16400) on SmallGroup(15,1), from github.com/QEC-pages/2BGA-codes @ 403d194c3f98f0cadc236aecbc4a8b6139ccf23c, abelian.zip, diswtabelian_wt5wtL2_order15_k4.txt, line 1. nonidentity supports a=[3], b=[2, 10].
provenance.notes: Literature reproduction of a published 2BGA code (arXiv:2306.16400; github.com/QEC-pages/2BGA-codes @ 403d194c3f98f0cadc236aecbc4a8b6139ccf23c). Checked against the live board: not equivalent to any existing entry.

contributed_by.method: Simulated annealing over site assignments on an integer grid with the repo's own research/local2d/fold_layout.search_layout (max-diameter objective, several bounding boxes and seeds); single layer at radius 4 tried first, then two layers at 7. Radius and per-site occupancy re-measured with the verifier's rule.

circuit.notes: Johnson-coil flagged interleaved two-block extraction (max_flags=2 per check, 6 data CX slots per round, X-check term slots [4, 1, 3, 5, 2], Z-check term slots [1, 4, 2, 0, 3] over terms A_0..A_1, B_0..B_2); verified against stim 1.16.0; RIS DEM search found nothing lighter than the claimed d_circ (generator: seed 0xC18C, 12 s per basis; independent re-check: seeds 0x5EED01 and 0x5EED02 at 1.5x the gate's trial budget, 180 s cap per basis)
